SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.
   C. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   B. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   D. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.
   C. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   B. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.
   D. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   D. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.
   B. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   D. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   B. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.
   C. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   D. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fieldwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa 5 5.2 The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Righ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Rights 5 5.4 African Diasporas 5 5.5 Citiz and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
